01 · The indicators

Built for the decisions you make in the seconds before you click.

Each one does a single job well. Together they answer the three questions every trade starts with: which way, where, and how much risk.

#2071 · Trend Scanner & Market Selector

Know which market to trade before the open.

Daily trend strength and direction for every market on your watchlist, so you spend the session on the market that's actually moving, not the one you happened to open.

  • Trend direction and strength per market
  • Scans your whole watchlist
  • Bullish, neutral and bearish split for the session

#2205 · TSMS & Fibs

Trend context and pullback levels on the same chart.

The Trend Scanner's trend read with Fibonacci levels drawn for you. Pullback zones sit right next to the trend, so you're not redrawing retracements every swing.

  • Fib levels plotted automatically
  • Pullback zones in trend context
  • Less manual drawing, cleaner charts

#2067 · ATR Order Automation

The same dollar risk in fast and slow markets.

ATR Order Automation sizes each trade from ATR and places your stop and target in NinjaTrader as you enter, so two contracts on a quiet day and two contracts on a fast day stop being the same mistake.

  • Contracts set from your dollar risk
  • Stop and target placed automatically
  • Same dollar risk in fast and slow markets

07 · Questions

Before you join.

Something else? Email support@startuptrading.com.

What do I need to use the indicators?

NinjaTrader 8 on a Windows computer and a NinjaTrader account. The account is free to create if you don't have one yet.

I already have NinjaTrader. Does that work?

Yes. After you join, you enter the email on your existing NinjaTrader account and the indicators are licensed to it. It can be different from the email you use on Whop.

How fast do I get access?

Discord access is granted at checkout. Indicator licensing happens as soon as you confirm your NinjaTrader email on the activation page, which takes about three minutes.

Do you need my NinjaTrader password?

Never. We only need the email address on your account, confirmed with a one-time code.

Is there an annual plan?

Yes: $495 a year, which works out to $41.25 a month (about 58% less than paying monthly). Same indicators, same Discord access. Pick "Annual" in the pricing section and check out right there.

I already bought ATR Order Automation or the Trend Scanner. Can I join?

Yes. You keep the license you bought; the membership never changes or removes it. When you join, the indicators you don't own yet are licensed to the same NinjaTrader account, and you get the Discord and everything else.

What happens if I cancel?

You keep everything until the end of the period you've paid for. After that, the indicators deactivate and Discord access ends. You can rejoin anytime and they come back.

Can I try something before I pay?

Yes. Jack's ATR Headliner Indicator is free. Get it here, use it on your charts, and join when you want the full set of indicators and the trade room.

Are these trade signals or financial advice?

No. They're analysis and order-management tools, and the room is for education and discussion. You make your own trading decisions.
